output.question: What is CDW's annual revenue?
output.answer: CDW Corporation (Nasdaq: CDW) reported net sales of $22.424 billion for its latest full fiscal year, 2025. That was up 6.8% from $20.999 billion in 2024 (results released February 4, 2026). Net income for 2025 was $1.067 billion, down 1.0% from $1.078 billion. Revenue has grown faster in 2026: Q3 2026 net sales (reported November 4, 2026) rose about 18% year over year to roughly $6.76 billion. Management raised its full-year 2026 outlook, so 2026 revenue will very likely come in well above 2025.

key_facts.fact: FY2025 net sales were $22,424 million, compared with $20,999 million in 2024, an increase of 6.8%.
FY2025 net income was $1,067 million, compared with $1,078 million in 2024, a decrease of 1.0%.
Q3 2026 net sales rose 18% year over year to $6.8 billion, and gross profit rose 10% to $1.4 billion.
Q3 2026 revenue was $6.755 billion, up 17.7% and 10.4% above the $6.12 billion consensus.
CDW raised its full-year 2026 outlook: it now expects gross profit growth at a mid- to high-single-digit rate and non-GAAP diluted EPS growth in the low double digits.

caveats: The latest complete annual figure is FY2025 ($22.424B). FY2026 results are not expected until about February 2027, and given the 2026 growth rates, 2026 revenue should be well above the 2025 figure.
The official earnings-release PDF and the Business Wire page could not be read (compressed PDF / HTTP 403). The FY2025 figures come from the full press-release text republished on Seeking Alpha.

The Q3 2026 figures come from secondary coverage (MarketBeat, Finviz/Earnings Whispers), not CDW's own release. Finviz put Q4 2025 growth at about 5%, while search results summarizing CDW's release gave 6.3% for that quarter.
I did not find a trailing-twelve-month (TTM) or year-to-date 2026 net sales total on any page I opened.
